questions.stem: A student dissolves 20 g of sodium chloride in water to make 500 cm³ of solution. What is the concentration in g/dm³?
questions.explanation: First convert 500 cm³ to dm³: 500/1000 = 0.5 dm³. Concentration = mass/volume = 20/0.5 = 40 g/dm³. A common mistake is forgetting to convert cm³ to dm³ (1 dm³ = 1000 cm³). Another approach: if 20 g is in 500 cm³ (half a dm³), then 40 g would be in 1 dm³.

questions.stem: A solution has a concentration of 0.5 mol/dm³. What mass of solute is in 250 cm³ of this solution if the Mr of the solute is 40?
questions.explanation: Volume = 250 cm³ = 0.25 dm³. Moles = concentration x volume = 0.5 x 0.25 = 0.125 mol. Mass = moles x Mr = 0.125 x 40 = 5.0 g. Remember to convert cm³ to dm³ before calculating, and then convert moles to mass using the Mr.

questions.stem: What does a concentration of 2 mol/dm³ mean?

options.text: There are 2 grams of solute in 1 dm³ of solution
There are 2 moles of solute dissolved in 1 dm³ of solution
There are 2 moles of solute in 1 cm³ of solution
There are 2 molecules of solute in 1 dm³ of solution

questions.explanation: A concentration of 2 mol/dm³ means there are 2 moles of solute dissolved in every 1 dm³ (1 litre) of solution. This is different from g/dm³ which measures mass per unit volume. To convert between the two: concentration in g/dm³ = concentration in mol/dm³ x Mr.

questions.stem: Which solution is more concentrated: Solution A (10 g of NaOH in 250 cm³) or Solution B (15 g of NaOH in 500 cm³)?
questions.explanation: Solution A: 10 g / 0.25 dm³ = 40 g/dm³. Solution B: 15 g / 0.5 dm³ = 30 g/dm³. Solution A is more concentrated even though it contains less total solute, because it has more solute per unit volume. A common mistake is comparing total mass rather than concentration.

questions.stem: What volume of a 0.1 mol/dm³ HCl solution contains 0.05 moles of HCl?
questions.explanation: Volume = moles / concentration = 0.05 / 0.1 = 0.5 dm³ = 500 cm³. You can rearrange the formula c = n/V to V = n/c. Since we need 0.05 mol from a 0.1 mol/dm³ solution, we need half of 1 dm³, which is 500 cm³.
